name: Why didn't my luxury home sell the first time it was listed?

mainEntity.name: Why didn't my luxury home sell the first time it was listed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury homes can fail to sell for several reasons, including incorrect pricing, ineffective marketing, poor property presentation, or timing issues in the market. Kelby Contreras will conduct a thorough analysis of the previous listing, comparing it to current market conditions and recent comparable sales in your specific area, such as Aventura or Coral Gables. Understanding these factors is a crucial preparation step before relisting, as it helps tailor a strategy for a successful sale.
